## (1) Legend

**SHA aliases:**

| Alias | Full SHA |
|---|---|
| a | aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa |
| b | bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb |
| c | cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc |
| d | dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd |
| e | eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee |
| 2R | 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222 |
| 3 | 3333333333333333333333333333333333333333 |
| 4 | 4444444444444444444444444444444444444444 |

**Identity:**
- Home is #12 on fix/retry with head a.
- Members, in order, are #13 (fix/cap, b) and #14 (fix/retry-docs, c).
- ROOT=/work/widget and W=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry.
- The process cwd never changes; every command uses `-C`.

**P (preflight):**
1. `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir` returns /work/widget/.git twice. `git -C ROOT rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` is empty.
2. Read the overrides file (runner only). NAME=fix-retry.
3. `git -C ROOT fetch origin`.
4. For each PR, `rev-parse --verify -q <head>^{commit}` succeeds and `rev-parse origin/<branch>` equals its supplied head.
5. BASE_SHA=`rev-parse origin/main`=d.
6. No PR is cross-repo, and `worktree list --porcelain` shows no other fix/retry checkout.

**Checks:**
- **RS:** `git -C W rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path rebase-merge` and `--git-path rebase-apply`; neither is a directory. `git -C W status --porcelain` is clean.
- **RB:** `git -C ROOT rev-parse -q --verify refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12`. Tip=`git -C ROOT rev-parse refs/heads/fix/retry`, never caller HEAD.
- **PRR:** `git -C W update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12 a` (pr-13 b, pr-14 c). On recovery, the existing refs are verified instead and left unchanged.
- **VM:** `git -C W merge-base --is-ancestor` for each of a, b and c against HEAD.
- **T:** thread GraphQL per #12/#13/#14 returns `Threads: none`.
- **RF (rebase failure):**
  - Run `git -C ROOT show d:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`; the runner is `node --test test/retry.test.mjs`.
  - Conflicted file: `diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` returns src/retry.ts.
  - Dispatch a foreground implementer helper with the `rebase --show-current-patch` payload; the helper fails.
  - Run `git -C W rebase --abort`, which exits 0. Then `rev-parse HEAD`, `branch --show-current` (fix/retry) and an empty `status --porcelain --untracked-files=all`.
  - Record `sync: unresolved - src/retry.ts`, `Member replay: #13 pending`, `#14 pending`.
  - **Deferred Task 1:** rebase onto origin/main and resolve src/retry.ts. Task 1 also completes the #13 and #14 replays and persists Rework base.

**Report R0:**
```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ <head7>
PR: acme/widget#12 / Pre-rework head: a
PR: acme/widget#13 / Pre-rework head: b
PR: acme/widget#14 / Pre-rework head: c
Base SHA: ddddddd
[Rework base] / member lines / base line
Threads: none (each PR)
```

## (2) Variants

| Var | Delta |
|---|---|
| A | P, RS, RB absent; tip e≠a; `is-ancestor a e`; `log --first-parent --format='%H %P %s' a..e`=e(a b, canonical #13). SYNC=merge. Reuse W, HEAD=e; PRR. `#13 eeeeeee (already landed)`; `merge --no-ff -m "merge PR #14 head ccccccc into PR #12" c`→fffffff; `merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main`→`merge: 1111111`. VM, T, R0@eeeeeee. |
| A-nw | P, RB absent; inspect from ROOT, tip e; same walk and recognition. Step 3 `git -C ROOT status --porcelain` clean; `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry`; HEAD=e. Then identical to A from PRR: #13 already landed, #14 fffffff, base 1111111, VM, T, R0@eeeeeee. |
| B | P, RS, RB absent; tip=2222222 (not caller 9999999). Walk returns 2222222 (single parent), so recovery fails. **STOP before writes:** "worktree /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry on fix/retry carries commits beyond PR #12's head (aaaaaaa) that are not member merges from this list; resolve by hand or remove the worktree." |
| R | P, RS (stale REBASE_HEAD ignored); RB=2R; `is-ancestor 2R 3`; pre-rework refs equal a/b/c, so SYNC=rebase. `cherry 3 b d` shows minus only: `#13 (already landed)`; `cherry 3 c d` shows plus. Reuse W, HEAD=3. Rebase (last-good 3, below): |
| | `rebase --no-rebase-merges origin/main` ok; `rebase --no-rebase-merges --onto HEAD d c`→4; `update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry HEAD`; `checkout fix/retry`; `update-ref refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12 HEAD`; validate rework-base ancestor HEAD. R0@3333333 plus `Rework base: 4`, `Base: main @ ddddddd - rebased: 3333333..4444444, 0 stop(s)`, `#14 4444444..4444444`, T. |
| R-nw | As R, but no RS; inspect from ROOT. Step 3 ROOT clean; `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry`; HEAD=3 (no update-ref, no reset). Then identical to R. |
| R-active | P; `--git-path rebase-merge` resolves to an existing directory. **STOP before sync or writes:** "worktree /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry has a rebase in progress; finish or abort it by hand". |
| R-mm1 | P, RS, RB valid; pre-rework/pr-14≠c. **STOP before writes:** the same message as B, with path W, branch fix/retry and "PR #12's head (aaaaaaa)". |
| R-mm2 | P, RS; `is-ancestor 2R 3` exits 1. **STOP before writes:** the same message as B, with path W, branch fix/retry and "PR #12's head (aaaaaaa)". |
| R-hf | As R through HEAD=3; save last-good 3. The home rebase conflicts, so RF runs. Proof after abort: HEAD=3 equals the saved actual tip, not a. No rework-base write. Validate HEAD=3. Report R0@3333333 with RF lines; deferred Task 1; T. |
| Fresh | P; RB absent; no branch or worktree; SYNC=rebase from caller. Step 3 ROOT clean; `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry` (DWIM); HEAD=a; PRR. Save last-good a; the home rebase conflicts, so RF runs. Proof: HEAD=a=PRE_REWORK_HEAD. Report R0@aaaaaaa with RF lines; deferred Task 1; T. |

## 1. Shared legend, command notation, preflight, and reports

I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

```text
ROOT=/work/widget
W=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
H=fix/retry
A=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
B=bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
C=cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
D=dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
E=eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
J=2222222222222222222222222222222222222222
T=3333333333333333333333333333333333333333
U=4444444444444444444444444444444444444444
Members=[#13:fix/cap:B,#14:fix/retry-docs:C]
PRE_REWORK_HEAD=A;BASE_SHA=D
```

Notation expands recursively; aliases substitute full values. Every command’s process cwd is ROOT. `G[…]` means argv `["git","-C",ROOT,…]`; `W[…]` substitutes W for ROOT.

Ordered common preflight **P**:

```text
G["rev-parse","--path-format=absolute","--git-dir","--git-common-dir"]
G["rev-parse","--show-superproject-working-tree"]
G["fetch","origin"]
For(A,H),(B,"fix/cap"),(C,"fix/retry-docs"):
 G["rev-parse","--verify","-q","<sha>^{commit}"]
 G["rev-parse","origin/<branch>"]
G["rev-parse","origin/main"]
G["worktree","list","--porcelain"]
G["rev-parse","refs/heads/fix/retry"]  # existing-branch variants
```

**Recovery checks K:** existing W only: resolve both rebase-state paths using `W["rev-parse","--path-format=absolute","--git-path",<"rebase-merge"|"rebase-apply">]`; inspect directories; `W["status","--porcelain"]`. Inspect recovery refs, prove J ancestry, and compare every pre-rework ref with its legend head. Canonical recovery instead proves A ancestry and runs `G["log","--first-parent","--format=%H %P %s",A+".."+<tip>]`.

**Provision N:** `G["status","--porcelain"]`, then `G["worktree","add",W,H]`; verify `W["rev-parse","HEAD"]` equals validated tip. No reset/update-ref.

**Provenance V:** verify retained refs on recovery; otherwise write each `W["update-ref","refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-<N>",<original>]`.

**Merge M:** members in order, skipping proven canonical merges:

```text
W["merge","--no-ff","-m","merge PR #14 head ccccccc into PR #12",C]
W["merge","--no-ff","--no-edit","origin/main"]
```

**Rebase S:** save actual tip; `W["rebase","--no-rebase-merges","origin/main"]`; replay #14 with `W["rebase","--no-rebase-merges","--onto","HEAD",D,C]`; update H to HEAD, checkout H, update rework-base to HEAD. Prove rework-base ancestry.

**Report Q:** read worktree listing and branch; print:

```text
Worktree ready at W
Branch: H
Base: H @ aaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#12
Pre-rework head: A
PR: acme/widget#13
Pre-rework head: B
PR: acme/widget#14
Pre-rework head: C
Base SHA: ddddddd
```

Append row outcomes. Merge validation proves ancestry of A,B,C. Rebase reports instead identify rebased base and rework-base.

**Refusal X(tip):**

```text
worktree /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry on fix/retry carries commits beyond PR #12's head (aaaaaaa) that are not member merges from this list; resolve by hand or remove the worktree.
```

No files, branches, or trees are removed.

## 2. Variant deltas

| Variant | Ordered narration and result |
|---|---|
| **A** | P; inspect actual E; K recognizes canonical #13 merge; force merge, never rebase. Reuse clean W; V; M→fffffff,1111111; validate original ancestry; Q. Outcomes: `Member merge: #13 eeeeeee (already landed)`; `Member merge: #14 fffffff`; `merge: 1111111`. No Task 1. |
| **A-no-worktree** | P reads local E, not session HEAD; canonical K succeeds without tree checks. N checks clean primary, adds existing H, verifies HEAD=E. V; M; ancestry validation; Q with A’s outcomes. Preserve E; no update-ref, reset, invented #13 commit, or rebase. |
| **B** | P reads actual local H, not unrelated session HEAD. Canonical walk includes ordinary single-parent 2222222 after E; recovery fails. Stop with X(2222222), identifying W, H, home #12 and original A through X and legend. No provisioning, refs, sync, or report. |
| **R** | P; K finds neither active directory; stale REBASE_HEAD is irrelevant. J ancestry and all original refs match; force rebase despite merge-forward. `G["cherry",T,B,D]` gives minus-only; corresponding C query gives plus. V; S→U; Q: #13 already landed, #14 replayed; rework-base U. |
| **R-no-worktree** | P inspects actual local T and recovery refs; validates J ancestry and original identities. N creates W on existing H and verifies T without overwriting it. Then R’s cherry commands, V, S, validation, and Q; same outcomes and rework-base U. |
| **R-active** | P; K resolves rebase-state paths and finds rebase-merge directory. Stop: `worktree /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry has a rebase in progress; finish or abort it by hand`. No sync, provisioning, ref writes, or ready report. Original identities and selected path remain legend-defined. |
| **R-mismatch** | P; K finds no active rebase, then either independently observes pre-rework/pr-14≠C or J not ancestral to actual T. Each variant stops before writes with X(T), using legend’s complete W/H/#12/A identity. No cherry, provisioning, sync, or Step 4 report. |
| **R-home-failure** | R through saved T and home rebase; conflict src/retry.ts. Helper fails with supplied scoped command `node --test test/retry.test.mjs`. Abort; verify exit 0, HEAD=T, branch H, empty all-untracked status. Q: `sync: unresolved - src/retry.ts`; both members pending. Task 1: rebase, resolve, replay both, persist rework-base. |
| **Fresh control** | P; clean-primary check; existing-branch DWIM add W,H; verify HEAD=A; V. Rebase-mode home sync saves A, then same conflict/helper/abort sequence. Prove restored HEAD=A, H, clean status—not T. Q: unresolved; both members pending. Task 1: rebase, resolve, replay both, persist rework-base. |

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved: After keeps every behaviour Before had for this case — legacy A/A-nw read the local fix/retry tip, prove `is-ancestor a e`, walk first-parent with `%H %P %s`, keep merge mode and skip #13 via the existing merge; R/R-nw validate rework-base ancestry and exact pre-rework refs, force rebase, use `cherry … d` to skip #13 and replay only #14, and report `Rework base: 4`; B/R-mm1/R-mm2 stop before writes with the full path/branch/aaaaaaa/carries-commits message and R-active stops with the rebase-in-progress message; R-hf saves and proves the actual tip 3 (explicitly 'not a') with branch and empty status, while Fresh proves a; the pending/Task 1 records are complete and no success is claimed. Two places in After are compressed to the point of fragility and are worth tightening without costing words: in row A, 'e(a b, canonical #13)' should spell the subject check (`merge PR #13 head bbbbbbb into PR #12`) so the canonical-subject validation is explicit rather than inferred, and in the Fresh row 'HEAD=a=PRE_REWORK_HEAD' is correct only because the two coincide — phrase it as 'HEAD=a equals the saved pre-attempt tip (which here is PRE_REWORK_HEAD)' so a reader does not take PRE_REWORK_HEAD as the general comparison target, which would contradict the R-hf proof against 3. Also 'Validate HEAD=3' in R-hf reads as a second, unexplained check; 'post-abort HEAD=3 verified' or dropping it would be clearer.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept: canonical recovery still reads the actual local tip, proves A ancestry and walks first-parent merges with %H %P %s while rebase recovery proves J ancestry and compares every pre-rework ref; A forces merge and skips #13 with eeeeeee; R forces rebase over merge-forward, uses cherry with BASE_SHA to skip #13 and replays only #14 to U with rework-base U; B/R-mismatch stop with the full-path/branch/aaaaaaa refusal and R-active with the rebase-in-progress message; both no-worktree rows add W on the existing branch and verify the tip without reset/update-ref; R-home-failure saves and proves T while Fresh control proves A; and the abort rows record `sync: unresolved - src/retry.ts`, mark both members pending and open Task 1. Two small tightening suggestions to make the After wording more self-evidently complete: the refusal template is written as `X(tip)` but the message text never uses the argument, so either drop the parameter or interpolate it so B/R-mismatch rows show the actual tip they refused on; and the Task 1 lines in R-home-failure/Fresh control say only `rebase, resolve` — spell out `rebase onto origin/main, resolve src/retry.ts` so the pending obligation names the target and conflict path explicitly rather than relying on the reader to carry them over from earlier in the row.
